WITH czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'CZK'
        AND ym."date" BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
),
eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND ym."date" BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
)
SELECT
    (czk.total_consumption - eur.total_consumption) AS consumption_difference
FROM
    czk_consumption czk,
    eur_consumption eur;
1482:
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4)
),
segment_growth AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        ("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") AS "increase_decrease",
        CASE
            WHEN "consumption_2012" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / "consumption_2012"::FLOAT) * 100
        END AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM
        segment_growth
    WHERE
        "consumption_2012" IS NOT NULL
        AND "consumption_2013" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    "segment",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM
    percentage_change
ORDER BY
    "percentage_increase" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "segment",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM
    percentage_change
ORDER BY
    "percentage_increase" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_2012 AS (
    SELECT
        t."customerid"
    FROM
        "transactions_1k" t
    WHERE
        t."date" = '2012-08-25'
        AND t."price" = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT
        y1."consumption" AS consumption_2012,
        y2."consumption" AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        "yearmonth" y1
    JOIN
        "yearmonth" y2 ON y1."customerid" = y2."customerid"
    JOIN
        customer_2012 c ON y1."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        y1."date" LIKE '2012%'
        AND y2."date" LIKE '2013%'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
    END AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM
    consumption_data;
